sentences.text: Initially, Procerosuchus was classified as a stagonolepidid alongside the genera Rauisuchus and Prestosuchus.
Friedrich von Huene later reassigned Procerosuchus to the family Rauisuchidae.
In 1972, Alfred Sherwood Romer assigned Procerosuchus as a possible member of the family Proterochampsidae.
Krebs in 1976, Chatterjee in 1985, and Carroll in 1988 all considered Procerosuchus to be a rauisuchid.
Procerosuchus does not appear to belong to Clade X, a monophyletic group of rauisuchians that includes poposaurids and ctenosauriscids.

Fossils of Procerosuchus come from the Late Triassic Santa Maria Formation in the Paleorrota Geopark of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, which dates to the Carnian age, though some estimates place the animal in the earlier Ladinian stage between 241.464 and 237 million years ago.
Procerosuchus lived during the Ladinian stage, between 241.464 and 237 million years ago.
